description: This PHP class 'Keys' in the SuiteCRM OAuth2 API namespace manages RSA key generation and retrieval for OAuth2 authentication, including methods to get public/private keys and generate keys if absent.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: A class providing functionality to generate and retrieve RSA public and private keys for OAuth2 security.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Returns the public RSA key as a string, generating keys if they do not exist.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns the private RSA key as a string, generating keys if they do not exist.

methods.name: setUpKeys
methods.description: Generates a new RSA key pair and saves the private key to 'private.key' and the public key to 'public.key' files.
